zh.title: 技能说“只读”，权限却允许写：谁说了算？
zh.summary: 一个代码审阅技能声明只读，权限文件却允许写目录。我们运行 Bulbasaur 的静态与动作时对照，再检查 CodeFlowMu 当前能证明什么。

en.title: The skill says read-only. The permission grants write. Which wins?
en.summary: A review skill claims to be read-only while its permission file allows writing. We ran Bulbasaur static and call-time checks, then tested the corresponding CodeFlowMu boundaries.
